视频和图片最大的区别就是「有变化」。先把变化说清楚。: The one thing video has that a still does not is change. Describe the change first.
主体基本保持静止，由环境元素产生动态，比如风、水、光影或人群: the subject stays essentially still while the environment supplies the motion — wind, water, shifting light or a crowd
主体完成一个连续的动作，动作过程完整可见: the subject performs one continuous action, with the whole movement staying visible
主体依次完成多个动作，动作之间有明确的先后关系: the subject performs several actions in turn, with a clear before-and-after order
主体从画面外进入画面，并在画面中停下: the subject enters the frame from off-screen and comes to a stop inside it
重点呈现面部表情的细微变化与情绪的流动: the focus is on subtle shifts of facial expression and the drift of emotion
两个主体之间发生互动，动作需要互相呼应: two subjects interact, and their movements need to answer each other
可以多选，会按顺序分配给分镜里的各个镜头。全片是一个镜头还是多个镜头，由「剪辑结: Multiple choice. They are handed to the shots in order. Whether the piece is one shot or several is decided by the cut structure.
大远景，主体在广阔环境中只占很小比例: an extreme wide shot, with the subject occupying only a small part of a vast environment
全景，主体完整入画并保留充分的环境信息: a wide shot with the subject fully in frame and plenty of surrounding context
中景，取景到人物腰部以上: a medium shot, framed from the waist up
近景，取景到人物胸部以上，突出面部表情: a close shot, framed from the chest up, bringing out the facial expression
特写镜头，聚焦于面部或关键细节: a close-up shot focused on the face or a key detail
极特写微距镜头，呈现肉眼难以看清的细节: an extreme close-up macro shot revealing detail the naked eye can barely make out
运镜是视频的「语气」。同一个画面，固定机位和环绕运镜完全是两回事。选了多个时，会: Camera movement is a video's tone of voice. Same shot, but a locked-off camera and an orbiting one are two different things. If you pick several, they are handed to the shots in order — the first goes to shot 1, and so on. A single-shot video only uses the first.
镜头缓慢推近，逐渐聚焦到主体上: the camera pushes in slowly, settling its focus on the subject
镜头缓缓拉远，逐渐揭示主体所处的环境: the camera pulls back slowly, gradually revealing the subject's surroundings
镜头水平摇动，像在扫视整个场景: the camera pans horizontally, as if scanning across the whole scene
镜头与主体同速横向移动，保持主体在画面中的相对位置: the camera moves laterally at the subject's speed, holding the subject in the same place in frame
镜头围绕主体做环绕运动: the camera orbits around the subject
镜头垂直升降，改变观察高度: the camera rises or falls vertically, changing the viewing height
手持拍摄，镜头有自然的轻微晃动，带来纪实感: handheld shooting with a natural, slight shake that gives it a documentary feel
无人机航拍视角，镜头大范围移动或飞越场景: a drone aerial viewpoint, the camera travelling widely or flying over the scene
第一人称视角运动，像观看者自己在移动: first-person camera movement, as if the viewer were the one moving
电影级影像质感，胶片色彩，丰富的明暗层次: cinematic image quality with film-stock colour and a rich tonal range
纪录片风格，光线与画面真实自然，不做修饰: a documentary style with natural, unadorned light and imagery
高端广告片质感，画面干净，光影精致: a high-end commercial look: clean imagery, refined lighting
二维动画风格，线条清晰，动作有作画感: a 2D animation style with clean linework and hand-drawn motion
定格动画风格，带有逐帧拍摄的轻微不连贯感: a stop-motion style with the slight jerkiness of frame-by-frame shooting
复古录像带质感，画面有噪点、色彩溢出与轻微抖动: a retro videotape look with noise, colour bleed and a slight wobble
赛博朋克影像风格，霓虹光源与冷色调城市环境: a cyberpunk look with neon sources against a cool-toned city
这决定全片有几个镜头 —— 一个镜头就不需要多个景别。: This decides how many shots the piece has — with a single shot you do not need several shot sizes.
按分镜顺序剪辑组接，镜头之间切换干净利落: cut together in storyboard order, with clean, decisive transitions between shots
一镜到底的长镜头，全片没有剪辑点: a single continuous take with no cuts anywhere
夜间城市灯光与霓虹，光源复杂有层次: city lights and neon at night, with layered, complex sources
逆光拍摄，主体呈现剪影或半剪影效果: shot against the light, so the subject reads as a silhouette or half-silhouette
阴天的柔和散射光，几乎没有硬阴影: soft diffused light under an overcast sky, with almost no hard shadow
片子多长？节奏如何？: How long is it, and what is the pace?
时长决定了能装下几个镜头 —— 3-5 秒塞四个分镜，每个镜头都来不及看清。: Duration decides how many shots will fit — cram four into three to five seconds and none of them registers.
时长 3-5 秒，节奏舒缓: three to five seconds long, with an unhurried pace
时长 5-10 秒，让动作完整展开: five to ten seconds, letting the action play out fully
时长 10-15 秒，节奏有推进: ten to fifteen seconds, with a pace that builds
时长 15 秒以上，节奏有起伏: over fifteen seconds, with a pace that rises and falls
要不要声音？要什么声音？: Do you want sound, and what kind?
如果你的工具不支持音频，选「不需要声音」即可。: If your tool does not support audio, just pick no sound.
只描述画面，不需要音频: describe the picture only, no audio needed
配合环境音，如风声、水声或城市背景音: with ambient sound — wind, water or city background
在关键动作处配合音效加以强调: with sound effects underlining the key actions
配乐具体是什么感觉？: What should the music actually feel like?
写清楚乐器与速度，配乐才不会跑偏。: Name the instruments and the tempo and the score will not drift off course.
以慢板钢琴独奏为主，音符稀疏，留白多: mostly slow solo piano, sparse notes and plenty of space between them
厚重、有故事感: Heavy, with a sense of story
以低沉的大提琴长音铺底，情绪厚重而有故事感: sustained low cello underneath, giving it weight and a sense of story
氛围音乐（Ambient），用持续的音垫铺底，不抢画面: ambient music, a continuous pad underneath that never competes with the picture
Lo-Fi 风格，带轻微底噪与慵懒的鼓点，生活气息浓: a lo-fi style with light background hiss and lazy drums, full of everyday texture
弦乐由弱渐强，在中后段把情绪推到最高点: strings swelling up from quiet, pushing the emotion to its peak in the middle-to-late section
电子合成器音色，冷调、有未来感，节奏规整: synthesizer tones, cool and futuristic, on a steady beat
这条片子想让观众的情绪怎么走？: How should the viewer's emotion travel through the piece?
四个镜头一个情绪，观众会觉得平。定一条走向，每个镜头的氛围才有推进。: Four shots at one emotional level feel flat. Set a direction and every shot's mood has somewhere to go.
情绪由静到动，前半段克制、后半段推起来: the emotion moves from still to moving: restrained in the first half, driving in the second
情绪由冷到暖，从疏离克制逐渐过渡到温暖: the emotion moves from cold to warm, shifting from distant and restrained into warmth
情绪层层递进，一镜比一镜更紧: the emotion builds step by step, each shot tighter than the last
情绪由紧到松，前半段压着，后半段放开: the emotion moves from tight to loose: held down in the first half, released in the second
情绪平缓流淌，不做强烈起伏: the emotion flows gently, with no strong rises or falls
镜头推近时，最想让人看清什么？: As the camera moves in, what matters most to see clearly?
特写和近景如果不指定焦点，模型会自己挑一个，常常挑错地方。: Leave the focus unset on a close-up or close shot and the model picks one itself — often the wrong thing.
把观众的注意力引到面部表情上: draw the viewer's attention to the facial expression
把观众的注意力引到眼神和视线的方向上: draw the viewer's attention to the eyes and the direction of the gaze
把观众的注意力引到手部动作上: draw the viewer's attention to the movement of the hands
把观众的注意力引到关键道具的材质与细节上: draw the viewer's attention to the material and detail of the key prop
把观众的注意力引到环境细节上，让背景里的质感清晰可见: draw the viewer's attention to the details of the setting, keeping the background texture sharp
把观众的注意力引到光影的变化上: draw the viewer's attention to the shifting of light and shadow
画面里必须出现哪些细节？: Which details must appear in the frame?
你写的具体细节会排在前面，一条分给一个镜头。想更具体，点「我自己补充」直接写，例: Details you write yourself come first, one per shot. To be more specific, choose write my own and type them straight in — raindrops on the umbrella, reflections in the puddles, the neon sign — separated by commas, one for each shot.
主体的穿着与外观细节清晰可见: the subject's clothing and appearance are clearly visible
面部与神态的变化清晰可见: shifts in the face and its expression are clearly visible
环境的材质与质感清晰可见: the materials and textures of the setting are clearly visible
空气里的水汽、尘埃或光斑清晰可见: moisture, dust or light flares in the air are clearly visible
地面或物体表面的反光与倒影清晰可见: reflections on the ground or on object surfaces are clearly visible
关键道具的细节清晰可见: the details of the key prop are clearly visible
背景里有缓慢移动的人群或车流: slow-moving crowds or traffic in the background
物体表面的纹理被放大呈现: the texture of object surfaces is magnified
这段视频投放在哪里？: Where will this video be shown?
横竖屏选错，平台会自动裁切，构图就全废了。: Pick the wrong orientation and the platform crops it for you — the framing is gone.
9:16 竖屏画幅，适配手机全屏观看: a 9:16 vertical frame, made for full-screen viewing on a phone
视频模型最容易翻车的地方都在这里，建议至少选几项。: These are where video models most often go wrong. Pick at least a few.
物体突然出现或消失: objects appearing or vanishing out of nowhere
